import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'; import { BRIDE, GROOM, EVENT } from '../config.js'; import { Corners, Divider } from './Ornaments.jsx'; /* Stages: closed -> closed envelope with wax heart seal opening -> flap opens, small card slides out revealed -> full invitation card is shown with the ENTER CELEBRATION button leaving -> intro fades away, main website is already mounted underneath */ export default function EnvelopeIntro({ onOpen, onEnter, onDone }) { const [stage, setStage] = useState('closed'); const [sceneGone, setSceneGone] = useState(false); const timers = useRef([]); const later = (fn, ms) => { const id = setTimeout(fn, ms); timers.current.push(id); }; useEffect( () => () => { timers.current.forEach(clearTimeout); timers.current = []; }, [] ); const openEnvelope = () => { if (stage !== 'closed') return; if (onOpen) onOpen(); // first user interaction: allows music to start setStage('opening'); later(() => setStage('revealed'), 2400); later(() => setSceneGone(true), 3300); }; const enterCelebration = () => { if (stage !== 'revealed') return; setStage('leaving'); onEnter(); later(onDone, 950); }; const isOpen = stage !== 'closed'; const showCard = stage === 'revealed' || stage === 'leaving'; return (
{!sceneGone && (

Engagement Invitation {GROOM.name} & {BRIDE.name}

{/* Small card that slides out of the envelope */}
ENGAGEMENT INVITATION {GROOM.name} & {BRIDE.name} {EVENT.dateUpper}
YOU ARE CORDIALLY INVITED {GROOM.name} & {BRIDE.name}
)} {showCard && (

ENGAGEMENT INVITATION

Together with the blessings of our families

Son of
{GROOM.parents}

{GROOM.name.toUpperCase()}

♥

Daughter of
{BRIDE.parents}

{BRIDE.name.toUpperCase()}

{EVENT.dateUpper}

{EVENT.time}

{EVENT.venueName}

{EVENT.venueAddress}

{EVENT.venueCity}

)}
); }
